verification.method: scripts/verify/sweden.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank, share, growth, density 2026/2100, land area
Deaths above births in 2026 (first since 1997–2001) and every later year; net migration positive except 1972–1973; 2016 record; 10 million in 2017
Births 1991 peak, 1999 low, 2010; fertility 2010 vs now
Peak 2079; 2100 above today, second-largest projected rise in Europe (over 5 million); life expectancy 1950 second only to the Netherlands (over 5 million), now and 2100
Least crowded European country over 10 million after Russia; second in Northern Europe after the UK; urban share; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 69 of 69 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
verification.result: All figures match. Statements about Europe are limited to countries over 5 or 10 million because some microstates rank higher. No image alt text on the page (the flag and charts carry aria-labels).
